newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistani stocks end down on profit-taking.
newsitem.headline: Pakistani stocks end down on profit-taking.

text.p: Pakistani stocks finished lower on Thursday amid profit-taking before the Friday-Saturday weekend, dealers said.

They said reports that the sale of $150 million worth exchangeable bonds of blue chip telecom utility PTCL had started abroad further powered the selling pressure amid uncertainty about its impact on PTCL's stock price in the domestic market.

The Karachi Stock Exchange 100-share index fell 13.26 points, or 0.81 percent, to close at 1,629.50 with 149 losers and 129 gainers. PTCL fell 1.85 rupees to 33.15 and Dewan Salman Fibre 1.40 to 41.20. -- Ovais Subhani 9221-5685192
